pages.text: It was growing parts for a body that was not its own. Held to mine (use one, and hold) a graft takes, and stays: an $(l)Unblinking Eye$() in the forehead (sight in the dark; nothing blinds it), $(l)Dorsal Tendrils$() from the spine (walls are climbable; sneak to cling), a $(l)Grasping Tentacle$() round the arm (two blocks more reach), $(l)Unbegotten Hide$() over the chest (armour).

pages.title: Cutting One Out
pages.text: They do not come out on their own. Lie on an empty $(l)Dissection Table$() (sneak and use it, nothing in hand): 16 drams of Time from my own pool run the body back to before the last graft I took, and it comes away whole. It hurts more than going in.
